Rustpotter 3.0.2 includes local Whispertype resource-efficiency modifications.
See vendor/rustpotter/UPSTREAM.md in the source distribution for details.
Original Apache-2.0 license and upstream notices are retained below.

Whispertype third-party notices

This file lists dependencies in the resolved Cargo graph, including build/test and platform-specific crates that may not be linked into a particular release.

Windows networking uses the system WinHTTP/Schannel libraries through windows-sys;
SHA-256 and secure random bytes use Windows CNG. Windows release builds do not
link ureq, rustls, ring or bundled root certificates. Their notices below remain
applicable to the Linux build. No additional crate package was introduced.
